news.title: Africa’s Moment? The Battle To Host Football’s 2030 World Cup Final
news.lede: Football’s ultimate fixture awaits its scheduling. The first major triumph of the 2030 World Cup will come long before the kick-off of the tournament, to be co-hosted by Morocco, Portugal and Spain. It will be the decision on which of the three countries gets the prestige of hosting the final, a call that world football’s governing body, FIFA, will make. Exactly when is unclear, and each passing month only heightens the tension ahead of the announcement.

news.title: Sardar Azmoun Returns To Iran National Squad After World Cup Omission
news.lede: Iran's star striker Sardar Azmoun has been recalled to the national football team, four months after his controversial omission from the World Cup roster. His return follows a social media post that reportedly angered Iranian authorities. Azmoun expressed his joy and readiness to fight for his country as Iran prepares for the Asian Cup.

news.title: Nicholas signs scholarship deal and earns Junior Matildas World Cup selection
news.lede: Adelaide United is delighted to announce that South Australian midfielder Maeve Nicholas has signed a one-year scholarship contract for the 2026/27 A-League Women season. The 17-year-old has also been selected in the 21-player CommBank Junior Matildas squad for the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup Morocco 2026™️. A product of WT Birkalla and Football South Australia’s development pathway, Nicholas made her A-League Women debut against Newcastle Jets in March before making a second senior appearance against Wellington Phoenix the following week. “I feel really excited and proud to continue my journey with Adelaide United.

news.title: CommBank Junior Matildas squad revealed for historic FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2026
news.lede: CommBank Junior Matildas Head Coach Michael Cooper has named the 21-player squad that will make history at the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup Morocco 2026™, where Australia is set to compete at the tournament for the first time. Australia secured its historic qualification at the AFC U-17 Women’s Asian Cup China 2026™ with a 2-0 quarter-final victory over Vietnam, before the team went on to finish fourth at the tournament. The squad retains the core group from its successful AFC U-17 Women’s Asian Cup campaign, reflecting the continuity and progress of a team that has developed together throughout the cycle. Sienna Calvanese and Rubi Sullivan come into the playing group, adding further depth ahead of the tournament.

news.title: Mbappe Calls Zidane Coaching France "Something Out of a Movie"
news.lede: TEMPO.CO, Jakarta - Kylian Mbappe described being coached by Zinedine Zidane for the French national team as something out of a movie. “Yes, years ago (he took me to the Real Madrid training ground). He was the one who picked me up and took me to Real Madrid, to the training complex. I was 13 or 14 at the time; it was a long time ago,” Mbappe told Diario AS on Monday, September 21, 2026, as cited by Antara.

news.title: World Cup viewers saw 65,000 unhealthy food and drink brands
news.lede: Football fans who watch the FIFA World Cup on television were exposed to junk... Fans watching the FIFA World Cup on TV were exposed to junk food, alcohol and gambling branding every seven seconds, a study has found.
